boundary: Proposed finite publication extension; baseline admits eight scalar leaves. Native Python authoring evidence, not direct C++ or HGL frontend conformance. Historical Python canonical types and native zoned_time are unavailable; no substituted parity claim.
rules: Each present scalar publishes its complete current value as delta, including equal repeats; silence is absent.
Preserve civil fields and exact zone spelling. Zoned values preserve instant, zone and offset; same instant need not mean equal value.
Raw eval output is retained separately from any input-horizon padding.
Repeated fresh processes and a second eval retain the same scalar values.
Mutating original ordinary lists and one exported capture must leave other native captures and runs independent; immutable scalars alone do not prove ownership.
Provider-dependent construction is observed separately before eval. Successful preconstructed-value replay without an active provider is a question to measure, not a precondition to assume.
